title: Compliance scratchpad: vendor checks & SOC2 evidence
content:
2026-03-12 - personal scratchpad (quick, messy)

Morning run-through: prioritized vendor reviews and evidence catch-up. Blocked: need updated AICPA letter from Vendor B; procurement says legal is following up.

Top priorities for the week (hard targets):
- Complete baseline evidence package for SOC2 control set A (CC6-1, CC7-2 coverage mapping) - target: Thu 2026-03-18
- Finish vendor classification for new suppliers onboarded Q4 2025 (20 total, 8 high/med risk) - target: Wed 2026-03-17
- Get signed encryption key handling attestation from Vendor B (follow up with legal & vendor PM) - target: EOD 2026-03-13

Live TODOs (quick hits):
- [ ] Pull timestamped access logs for shared S3 bucket used by analytics team (JIRA: OPS-210) - note: ask infra on retention filter (they archive older than 90d).
- [ ] Upload annotated screenshots for change-control evidence (PR approvals, merged-by, JIRA link) to evidence folder.
- [x] Drafted vendor questionnaire adjustments for data processing controls (saved v0.2)
- [ ] Run redaction check on sample support tickets (5 samples) for PII leakage - reach out to support lead.
- [ ] Confirm who owns vendor risk score for IBM Cloud storage (vendor id: VEND-IBMC-34)

Vendor review notes (scratchy):
- Vendor A (VEND-A-12) - infra monitoring: OK, SOC2 cert exists but expired 2024-12. Need recent bridge letter or ISO cert. Contact: qa@vendora.com (ticket open: JIRA-SEC-398).
- Vendor B (VEND-B-02) - encryption key custodian ambiguity: doc says keys managed by vendor, but KMS integration suggests customer-managed in practice. Action: ask Vendor PM for KMS architecture diagram + attestation. Legal loop-in: @Sofia.
- Vendor C (VEND-C-51) - subprocessor list incomplete; procurement to escalate. High risk if data flows to EU region without DPAs updated.

Evidence mapping quick table (mental):
- CC6-1 (Access provisioning) => evidence: user onboarding checklist, IAM groups export, PR approvals for access grants (PR-3456), SRE runbook snippet.
- CC7-2 (Change management) => evidence: merge policy doc, PR review logs, deployment tickets (OPS-210).
- CC9-3 (Encryption at rest/in transit) => evidence: KMS configs, vendor key attestation, TLS cert expiry monitoring.

Questions / open items to clear:
- Do we accept vendor SOC2 Type II with a bridge letter older than 9 months? Drafted rationale but need sign-off from Legal.
- Who is the canonical owner of the vendor questionnaire now? Procurement ops vs Security intake? (Procurement says ops, security wants final review).
- Are infra logs stored long enough to demonstrate incident response timelines for past 6 months? SRE says yes for critical resources but not for ephemeral test buckets.

Short comms drafts (for Slack/email):
- To Vendor B PM (quick): "Hi — need KMS architecture diagram and a short attestation about who holds KMS keys for Redwood workloads. This is for SOC2 evidence; deadline 2026-03-18. Happy to set a quick 20-min call."
- To Legal (Sofia): "Can you confirm acceptable window for bridge letters? I propose 12 months with mitigating review if 9-12 months. Will draft rationale + examples."

Quick notes to self (timers & traps):
- Don’t over-annotate screenshots; redaction must remove internal ticket IDs that leak customer PII.
- Keep a single evidence index doc (spreadsheet) and reference cell IDs in this scratchpad when noting items uploaded.
- Archive old vendor questionnaires (v1) into /evidence/archive with prefix "v1-" before replacing.

Meeting prep for Fri vendor sync (30m):
- Bring: current vendor risk summary, outstanding evidence items, deadlines, ask list for each vendor.
- Goal: lock down attestation due dates and owner for each ask.

Quick timeline sketch:
- Mon 3/15: vendor questionnaire finalization + dispatch
- Wed 3/17: interim review with procurement (list of escalations)
- Thu 3/18: baseline evidence package submission for internal audit

Brain dump (random):
- Consider adding a short "attestation template" (one pager) that vendors sign: simple lines for KMS, subprocessor list, access to logs, backup retention. Could speed responses.
- Think about automated reminders from the evidence spreadsheet (zapier/google script) to vendors at 7d/3d/1d before due date.

Last 10 minutes:
- Pinged legal re: bridge letter (Sofia)
- Opened JIRA-SEC-412 vendor classification list, added 4 new vendors (incl. VEND-C-51)
- Added screenshots to /evidence/pending (need to annotate)

Next actions (priority order):
1) Follow up with Vendor B PM for KMS attestation (call if no reply by Tuesday).
2) Confirm retention windows for infra logs with SRE (quick doc link in slack).
3) Finish uploading access control evidence and annotate with PR/JIRA references.

Random reminders (personal):
- Lunch with product security on Wed 3/17 (move if audit deadline squeezes).
- Remember to carve 90-min deep-focus block for evidence packaging on Thu morning.

End of scratchpad. Keep this page as the running daily log for SOC2 vendor/evidence tasks; will prune into formal checklist when items stabilized.

-- Maya
